dct_description_sm: Aerial view to horizon. Relief shown by shading and landform. Partial cadastral map of Despatch, New York (later East Rochester) showing blocks, lots, and lot numbers. In lower left margin: School, shops, stores, and factories, suburban homes with city conveniences. In lower right margin: Fine business and residential lots on easy payments, write for further information. "Vanderbilt Improvement Company Owners, Despatch, N.Y." LC copy imperfect: Torn at edges. Includes notes and col. views of residential and commercial properties and government facilities. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Dealer/source: John Carbonell Acquisitions control no.: 2006-134
